original_evidence.text: | Psono (client) | github.com/psono/psono-client | Multi-target: Electron desktop, Chrome/Firefox extensions, web client | Y (Electron only) | auto chk (hourly, `updateInterval: "1 hour"`) + auto dl/inst per `update-electron-app`/Electron `autoUpdater` defaults (Squirrel.Mac / Squirrel.Windows background update-and-relaunch); browser-extension builds rely entirely on the browser store's own auto-update, not app code | Y (Electron: Squirrel applies the downloaded update package and relaunches) | HTTPS via `update-electron-app` → defaults to `update.electronjs.org` proxy of the GitHub releases feed (`repo: "psono/psono-client"`); TLS validation ENFORCED (no TLS-bypass code found in src/electron) | N (electron `autoUpdater`/Squirrel feed JSON is not separately signed by the app) | OS-code-signing (Squirrel.Mac requires the update package be signed with the same code-signing identity as the running app; Squirrel.Windows/NSIS via `electron-squirrel-startup` similarly expects a matching signed installer) — no in-app hash/signature check found | n/a (relies on OS keychain/Authenticode trust of the app's own code-signing certificate, not an app-embedded key) | src/electron/index.js:6-9 (`require("update-electron-app")({repo:"psono/psono-client", updateInterval:"1 hour", logger: require("electron-log")})`), src/electron/package.json:26 (`"update-electron-app": "^2.0.1"`), src/electron/index.js:19-21 (`electron-squirrel-startup` used for Windows install/uninstall shortcuts, consistent with Squirrel-based auto-update); negative grep for TLS bypass patterns in src/electron (verified 2026-08-19) |
